To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have constructed a new class of Calabi–Yao cones, that we have shown that the dual quiver theory is a superconformal quiver gauge theory with a non-trivial superpotential, and that we have shown the existence of a new class of ( p, q ) -forms on these cones.

(1) we find a new type of superconformal quiver gauge theory which we call Labc superconforal field theory (LabcSCFT), and (2) the LabcSCFT has a new type of non-trivial superconformal symmetry, which we call the LabcSC symmetry
we found new Calabi–Yaus and that we found a way to use them to describe flows of quiver gauge theories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of the D3-branes, which is described by a superconformal quiver gauge theory.
the following: • The construction of new classes of Calabi–Yaus cones with nontrivial topology, and the corresponding quiver gauge theories.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the D3-brane dynamics on the resolved cones is governed by the Labc superconfromal field theories.
the D3-branes probe the full moduli space of the L a b c quiver theories.
the D3-brane probe of a resolved cone is equivalent to the D3-branes in the dual gauge theory with the ranks reduced and/or the scalar operators acquiring vacuum expectation values.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ( 2, k ) -forms are obtained by blowing up the ( 2 k − 2 ) -cycles of L a b c.
, for any given Calabi–Yaus, we obtain a set of quiver gauge theories which flow to a superconformal fixed point in the infrared.
the D3-branes can flow from a superconformal theory to a non-conformal theory by moving in the moduli spaces of the resolved cones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are many more Calabi–Yaus with harmonic forms which can be used to construct new superconformal gauge theories.
there exist many new superconformal fixed points in the moduli spaces of these quiver gauge theories.
the dual quiver theory flows to an N = 2 superconformal theory in the infrared.
